doc_name: Annex B - RG-T3725-P007 - Terms of Reference.pdf
title: Support to the Implementation of the More Lights for the Amazon Program
objectives: Develop an optimal georeferenced electrification plan to facilitate universal access to electricity in remote and isolated areas of the Legal Amazon (Amazonas, Acre, Pará and Roraima), identifying and characterizing beneficiaries and determining the least-cost off-grid electrification solutions using individual photovoltaic systems and PV mini-grids.

feasibility_assessment.assessment: Feasible with an experienced multidisciplinary team and adequate access to geospatial and socioeconomic datasets.
feasibility_assessment.rationale: The 9-month schedule is ambitious but achievable. The main risks are the availability and quality of geospatial and socioeconomic data, validation of beneficiary locations, integration of multiple data sources, and calibration of the georeferenced optimization model. The timeline is feasible provided that data access is secured early and stakeholder reviews occur according to schedule.

budget: USD 100,000 fixed-price consulting contract. Payments: Product 1 (10%), Products 2 and 3 (25%), Product 4 (25%), Product 5 (40%).
